config.loss: Equal training weight across three state-transition strata
config.selection: All final fits; no best epoch, seed or variant; development only

candidate_readout.attention: softmax(log(token_prior) + dot(Wq[schema_pair], Wk[token])/sqrt(64)) over tokens only
candidate_readout.attention_work: Forward: schema query B*Q*C once, token keys B*T*L, token logits B*T*Q*C*L; step repeats schema projection
candidate_readout.belief_feature: own probability and entropy divided by log(valid candidate count)
candidate_readout.normalization: log_b -= logsumexp(log_b) before features/transition and after each real update
candidate_readout.observation_mode_binding: Caller authenticates raw contextual tokens and chunk-weighted priors

observation_paths.tokens: [B,T,L,D]; shared raw tokens, candidate-specific pooled evidence

candidate_readout.old_fit_scope: parameter loading possible, but not corrected training or empirical efficacy evidence
candidate_readout.padding: exact original state values; no normalization committed on padded turns
candidate_readout.parameter_schema: same as DialogueCopyMemory for the same method and dimensions
candidate_readout.pooling: L2-normalize weighted raw token sum, eps=1e-12; zero vector remains zero
candidate_readout.representation_control: Same normalized head; two added bias-free projections; no encoder calls
candidate_readout.scope: conditional stochastic transition; not calibrated Bayes or architecture novelty
candidate_readout.token_prior: Positive on token_mask, zero elsewhere; real-turn sum within 2e-6 of one

updates.candidate_gru: shared per-candidate GRU then candidate softmax
updates.readout: softmax(write logits); no learned state feedback
